# ICEN Medical Equipment Limited

> ICEN is a Guangzhou-based B2B supplier of hospital and veterinary medical equipment,
> founded in 2015 and serving distributors, hospitals, clinics and healthcare programmes
> in more than 150 countries. Principal brands are Mindray and Edan. Every product page
> states specifications as published by the manufacturer; fields the manufacturer does
> not publish are marked "Not published" rather than estimated.

## What ICEN supplies

- New, manufacturer-authorised clinical and veterinary equipment for hospitals, distributors
  and project buyers — not consumer or home-use devices.
- Sourcing and project support: configuration confirmation, documentation, and
  destination-market requirement checks before quotation.
- OEM / ODM programmes for distributors and private-label buyers.

## Product categories

- [Ultrasound Imaging](https://icenmedical.com/products/ultrasound/): Mindray and Edan diagnostic
  ultrasound systems for general imaging, obstetrics, cardiology and point-of-care use.
- [Veterinary Diagnostics](https://icenmedical.com/products/veterinary/): veterinary ultrasound,
  chemistry, haematology and blood gas platforms for companion-animal and mixed practice.
- [Veterinary Surgery & Imaging](https://icenmedical.com/products/veterinary-surgery/): Mindray
  VeLED surgical and examination lighting, and the Vetina rigid and flexible endoscopy series.
- [Hematology & Laboratory](https://icenmedical.com/products/hematology-laboratory/): Mindray
  automated haematology analysers for routine CBC and 5-part differential reporting.
- [ICU & Ventilation](https://icenmedical.com/products/ventilators/): ICU, transport and
  non-invasive ventilation.
- [Patient Monitors](https://icenmedical.com/products/patient-monitors/): BeneVision, ePM, VS and
  uMEC multiparameter monitoring for bedside and transport use.
- [Patient Monitoring & Cardiac Care](https://icenmedical.com/products/monitoring/): ECG machines,
  defibrillators and AEDs for cardiac diagnosis and emergency response.
- [Anesthesia Systems](https://icenmedical.com/products/anesthesia/): Mindray anaesthesia delivery
  systems for operating theatres.
- [Clinical Chemistry & Laboratory](https://icenmedical.com/products/clinical-laboratory/):
  chemistry analysers, cellular analysis lines and microplate readers.
- [Digital Radiography (DR)](https://icenmedical.com/products/radiology/): fixed ceiling-mounted and
  mobile DR X-ray systems.
- [Infusion Systems](https://icenmedical.com/products/infusion/): infusion pumps, syringe pumps and
  infusion supervision systems.
